practicas.texto: Ana started her new job at the library two weeks ago. She arrives fifteen minutes early every day and organizes the returned books before opening. Her supervisor, Mr. Ortiz, says she is very responsible. Ana still doesn't know how to use the new inventory system, so a coworker is teaching her this week.

afirmaciones.texto: Ana arrives fifteen minutes late every day.
afirmaciones.cita: She arrives fifteen minutes early every day
afirmaciones.explicacion: Falso. El texto dice que llega temprano, no tarde.

afirmaciones.texto: Ana's supervisor thinks she is very responsible.
afirmaciones.cita: Her supervisor, Mr. Ortiz, says she is very responsible
afirmaciones.explicacion: Verdadero, tal cual lo dice el texto.

afirmaciones.texto: Ana studied library science at university.
afirmaciones.cita: Ana started her new job at the library two weeks ago
afirmaciones.explicacion: No se dice: el texto no menciona sus estudios.

practicas.texto: Last month, Ana asked her supervisor an indirect question: 'Could you tell me if I could take next Friday off?' Mr. Ortiz checked the schedule and agreed, as long as she found someone to cover her shift. Ana asked her coworker Beto, and he accepted right away. On Friday, Ana visited her family in another city.

afirmaciones.texto: Ana asked for the following Monday off.
afirmaciones.cita: if I could take next Friday off
afirmaciones.explicacion: Falso. Pidió el viernes, no el lunes.

afirmaciones.texto: Beto agreed to cover Ana's shift.
afirmaciones.cita: Ana asked her coworker Beto, and he accepted right away
afirmaciones.explicacion: Verdadero, tal cual lo dice el texto.

afirmaciones.texto: Ana's family lives in the same city as her.
afirmaciones.cita: Ana visited her family in another city
afirmaciones.explicacion: No se dice directamente si vive en la misma ciudad o no antes de la visita.
